experiment: E03 pilot: value-calibrated halting on frozen E01 artifacts

labels.stop: immediate[baseline_action]: measured FP32 CE after T=1
labels.continue: q_pi0[baseline_action]: measured FP32 CE after T=4 with frozen pi0 tail
labels.binary_decision_note: E01 artifacts contain exactly two depths, so this pilot compares stop-after-round-1 vs continue-to-rounds; no intermediate-depth stopping labels exist and none are fabricated

value_student.source: students.pt frozen by E01; trained on the train split with h as the only input

entropy.reason: full-vocab head logits per state were never materialized by E01 (see eval/counterfactual.py); states_*.pt store only h, targets and CE labels, so entropy cannot be computed without re-executing the head, which is out of scope for this reuse-only pilot

maxprob.reason: full-vocab head probabilities per state are not stored in the E01 artifacts and are not recomputed here

logit_margin.reason: top-2 vocabulary logits per state are not stored in the E01 artifacts and are not recomputed here

hidden_change.reason: only the pre-FFN h entering the adaptive layer is cached; no per-round hidden states exist in the artifacts

value_student.selection_rule: lowest validation mean NLL among thresholds with validation mean rounds <= budget; ties prefer fewer rounds; thresholds frozen before test

1.5.tau_meaning: continue iff signal > tau; for the value student the signal is the predicted (stop_nll - continue_nll), so tau absorbs lambda * extra continuation cost

2.tau_meaning: continue iff signal > tau; for the value student the signal is the predicted (stop_nll - continue_nll), so tau absorbs lambda * extra continuation cost

oracle.note: label-informed (uses realized deltas on test); an upper-bound reference only, never mixed into the deployable student results above

scope_notes: debug-scale pilot: counts and SEs come from the small E01 coverage_remediation splits only
only the last adaptive layer is studied; no wall-clock/FLOPs claims (see E11 for system-level)
quality-compute trade-off is measured in realized NLL vs average rounds/expert calls, not in latency
